prerequisites: Differential and integral calculus for functions of one real variable
Linear algebra and analytic geometry in the plane and in the space

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire the mathematical tools needed for engineering applications through the study of the fundamentals of differential and integral calculus for functions of several variables, together with methods for solving ordinary differential equations.

Develop the ability of modeling and solving practical engineering problems, and increase the ability of choosing independently the best solution techniques, through applications in applied sciences like chemistry and physics.
Acquire the ability to use mathematical laws in general scientific problems.
The expertise acquired in this course will be needed in order to study the material of later courses.
Improve the ability to develop independent thought and learning capabilities through individual and collective problem-solving sessions.
Help developing communication skills through oral presentations of the topics taught in the course, with the language proper of the basic disciplines of the degree course.

syllabus_topics: Regular curves and elements of the differential geometry of curves in R^2 and R^3
Infinitesimal and differential calculus for functions of several variables: limits
Work and flux of a vector field
Ordinary differential equations: existence and uniqueness theorems
Linear ordinary differential equations and selected classes of nonlinear ordinary differential equations
Smooth curves and elements of differential geometry of the curves in R2 and R3
Infinitesimal and differential calculus for functions of several real variables: limits
Flux and circulation of vector fields
Ordinary differential equations, existence and uniqueness results
Linear ordinary differential equations and some ordinary nonlinear differential equations
Fourier series and their application to solving certain ordinary differential equations
assessment_rules: The student will be admitted to the oral test only if he passed the written test. The passing grade for both the written test and the oral test is 18/30. The overall rating comes from the comparative evaluation of the written and the oral test. The honour is bestowed upon those students who have performed the tests in a correct and exhaustive way and have shown a particular excellence and independence of thought.
